purpose: Clean independent recomputation of the sealed FCLR-011 volatility PASS (C2 vs B1 4.94% QLIKE, CI [-0.032546,-0.001418], 5 instruments, 3 blocks, test 2026-05-08..2026-08-06) from cached Binance inputs, without the Git-LFS panel and without the heuristic run_trackc_* predictor.

target.name: rv24h
target.definition: next-24h realized variance of mark-price log returns: sum of squared 1h log returns over t+1..t+24, forward-looking from decision time t
target.source_series: klines close (mark price unavailable in cache)
target.source_limitation: markPriceKlines/indexPriceKlines/premiumIndexKlines are absent from the 2026 cache; close-to-close RV and close-based premium proxies are used and recorded in the build report

primary_metric: paired out-of-sample QLIKE, C2 vs B1

inference.bootstrap: circular block over complete UTC days

stop_rule.on_failure: INADMISSIBLE with exact failing minima; do not relax after outcomes

verdict_rule.REPRODUCED: materially consistent with sealed +4.94% under the frozen design
verdict_rule.NOT_REPRODUCED: fails to reproduce the sealed result
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: data/coverage/numerical limits prevent a clean verdict
